note: Gold ECG revised using the same annotation philosophy as the chart/graphic-tools gold example: only explicit visible headings, labeled instructional units, and clearly delimited diagram/table labels are retained. No paraphrased body-text concepts are introduced. Strict compiler hierarchy is respected: a child of COURSE with children is MODULE; a child of MODULE with children is UNIT; leaves are KC.

annotation_decisions: The table of contents is navigation evidence only and is not represented as a node.
Body-text paraphrases from the earlier gold were removed.
Page 11 flowchart labels are retained as KCs because they are explicit visual instructional units.
Annex table row labels are retained as KCs when they are explicitly printed instructional units.
Top-level headings without explicit children remain standalone KCs, as in the chart-gold example.
Strict hierarchy applied: COURSE > MODULE > UNIT > KC according to compiler behavior.
